description: The terrain of a map as the editor saves it: its size, the units, props, decals, items and effects placed on it, and the named coordinates and starting areas a match uses.

Width.title: Width
Width.description: The width of the terrain in cells.

Depth.title: Depth
Depth.description: The depth of the terrain in cells.

Units.title: Units
Units.description: The units and buildings the map places when a match starts.

items.description: One unit or building the map places on the battlefield when a match starts, with where it stands and whose it is.

TemplateId.title: TemplateId
TemplateId.description: The unit or building template placed here.

PosX.title: PosX
PosX.description: Where the unit stands across the map.

PosY.title: PosY
PosY.description: How high above the ground the unit stands.

PosZ.title: PosZ
PosZ.description: Where the unit stands along the map.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the unit's model size for this placement.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: The slot the unit belongs to, which decides the player whose colour it wears.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: The level this unit starts at, which sets its attributes and growth. A level of 0 keeps the template's own level.

Props.title: Props
Props.description: The props the map places for scenery or to block movement.

items.description: One prop the map places on the battlefield, with where it stands and which way it faces.

PosX.title: PosX
PosX.description: Where the prop stands across the map.

PosY.title: PosY
PosY.description: How high above the ground the prop stands.

PosZ.title: PosZ
PosZ.description: Where the prop stands along the map.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the prop's model size for this placement.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: The level this prop starts at, which sets its capacities and resistances. A level of 0 keeps the template's own level.

Decals.title: Decals
Decals.description: The decals the map projects onto the ground.

items.description: One decal the map projects onto the ground, with where it sits and which way it is turned.

PosX.title: PosX
PosX.description: Where the decal sits across the map.

PosY.title: PosY
PosY.description: How high above the ground the decal sits.

PosZ.title: PosZ
PosZ.description: Where the decal sits along the map.

RotationX.title: RotationX
RotationX.description: How far the decal is tipped over its sideways axis.

RotationY.title: RotationY
RotationY.description: How far the decal is turned around the vertical axis.

RotationZ.title: RotationZ
RotationZ.description: How far the decal is rolled over its forward axis.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the decal's size for this placement.

Items.title: Items
Items.description: The items the map leaves lying on the ground to be collected.

items.description: One item the map places on the ground, waiting for a unit to walk over and collect it.

PosX.title: PosX
PosX.description: Where the item lies across the map.

PosY.title: PosY
PosY.description: How high above the ground the item lies.

PosZ.title: PosZ
PosZ.description: Where the item lies along the map.

Vfx.title: Vfx
Vfx.description: The visual effects the map places in the world.

items.description: One visual effect the map places in the world, with where it sits, how it is turned and scaled, and the configuration this placement uses.

VfxId.title: VfxId
VfxId.description: The visual effect template placed here.

PosX.title: PosX
PosX.description: Where the effect sits across the map.

PosY.title: PosY
PosY.description: How high above the ground the effect sits.

PosZ.title: PosZ
PosZ.description: Where the effect sits along the map.

RotationX.title: RotationX
RotationX.description: How far the effect is tipped over its sideways axis.

RotationY.title: RotationY
RotationY.description: How far the effect is turned around the vertical axis.

RotationZ.title: RotationZ
RotationZ.description: How far the effect is rolled over its forward axis.

ScaleX.title: ScaleX
ScaleX.description: The multiplier applied to the effect's width for this placement.

ScaleY.title: ScaleY
ScaleY.description: The multiplier applied to the effect's height for this placement.

ScaleZ.title: ScaleZ
ScaleZ.description: The multiplier applied to the effect's depth for this placement.

NormalOffset.title: NormalOffset
NormalOffset.description: How far the effect is lifted along the surface it sits on, so it does not sink into it.

Config.title: Config
Config.description: The configuration this placement spawns the effect with, when it should differ from the template it names.

VfxId.title: VfxId
VfxId.description: The identifier abilities, weapons and attachments name this visual effect by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the visual effect shows in the editor.

PrimitiveType.title: PrimitiveType
PrimitiveType.description: The shape the effect is drawn with, which decides how its texture is wrapped and how it moves over its life.

ParticleConfig.title: ParticleConfig
ParticleConfig.description: The particle system the effect emits, when its primitive type is a real particle system rather than wrapped geometry.

ParticleId.title: ParticleId
ParticleId.description: The identifier the particle system is known by in the editor.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the particle system shows in the editor.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: How many particles one emission produces.

Lifetime.title: Lifetime
Lifetime.description: How long each particle lives before it disappears.

Explosiveness.title: Explosiveness
Explosiveness.description: How much of the emission is released at the very start rather than over the effect's life, which turns a stream into a burst.

Randomness.title: Randomness
Randomness.description: How much each particle's start is randomised, so a burst does not read as one wave.

LocalCoords.title: LocalCoords
LocalCoords.description: Whether the particles move with the effect they belong to instead of staying where they were emitted.

EmitterShape.title: EmitterShape
EmitterShape.description: The shape the particles are emitted inside.

SphereRadius.title: SphereRadius
SphereRadius.description: How far from the emitter's centre particles may start when its shape is a sphere.

BoxExtents.title: BoxExtents
BoxExtents.description: How far from the emitter's centre particles may start on each axis when its shape is a box.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

RingRadius.title: RingRadius
RingRadius.description: How far from the emitter's centre the ring the particles start on sits.

RingInnerRadius.title: RingInnerRadius
RingInnerRadius.description: The inner edge of the ring the particles start on, which makes it a band rather than a circle.

RingHeight.title: RingHeight
RingHeight.description: How tall the band the particles start in is.

Direction.title: Direction
Direction.description: The direction the particles are emitted in, before their spread is applied.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

SpreadDegrees.title: SpreadDegrees
SpreadDegrees.description: How wide a cone the particles are emitted into around their direction.

InitialVelocityMin.title: InitialVelocityMin
InitialVelocityMin.description: The slowest speed a particle leaves the emitter with.

InitialVelocityMax.title: InitialVelocityMax
InitialVelocityMax.description: The fastest speed a particle leaves the emitter with.

Gravity.title: Gravity
Gravity.description: The acceleration every particle is pulled with, which is what makes sparks fall.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

LinearAccel.title: LinearAccel
LinearAccel.description: A constant acceleration added to every particle on each axis.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

RadialAccel.title: RadialAccel
RadialAccel.description: How strongly particles are pushed away from the emitter's centre as they fly.

TangentialAccel.title: TangentialAccel
TangentialAccel.description: How strongly particles are pushed around the emitter's centre as they fly, which makes them swirl.

Damping.title: Damping
Damping.description: How quickly a particle's speed is bled away over its life, which slows a burst to a drift.

InitialScaleMin.title: InitialScaleMin
InitialScaleMin.description: The size a particle starts at when it is the smallest of the emission.

InitialScaleMax.title: InitialScaleMax
InitialScaleMax.description: The size a particle starts at when it is the largest of the emission.

EndScaleRatio.title: EndScaleRatio
EndScaleRatio.description: The size a particle ends at, as a fraction of the size it started at. Zero shrinks away, one never changes.

ColorStart.title: ColorStart
ColorStart.description: The colour a particle starts its life in.

ColorMid.title: ColorMid
ColorMid.description: The colour a particle passes through halfway through its life.

ColorEnd.title: ColorEnd
ColorEnd.description: The colour a particle ends its life in.

AlphaStart.title: AlphaStart
AlphaStart.description: How opaque a particle is when it starts its life.

AlphaMid.title: AlphaMid
AlphaMid.description: How opaque a particle is halfway through its life.

AlphaEnd.title: AlphaEnd
AlphaEnd.description: How opaque a particle is when its life ends.

BlendMode.title: BlendMode
BlendMode.description: How the particles are mixed with what is behind them.

ParticleTexture.title: ParticleTexture
ParticleTexture.description: The texture drawn on each particle when it is drawn as a camera-facing quad.

MeshAssetPath.title: MeshAssetPath
MeshAssetPath.description: The model drawn for each particle when it is drawn as a mesh, such as a chip of debris.

Stages.title: Stages
Stages.description: The stages the effect plays over its life, each with its own trigger, timing and look.

items.description: One stage of a visual effect's life: which effect plays, when it starts, how long it lasts and how large it is drawn.

EffectId.title: EffectId
EffectId.description: The visual effect the stage plays.

DelaySeconds.title: DelaySeconds
DelaySeconds.description: How long after the trigger the stage starts.

DurationSeconds.title: DurationSeconds
DurationSeconds.description: How long the stage lasts before it is cleaned up.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the stage's size.

SingleInstance.title: SingleInstance
SingleInstance.description: Whether only one of this stage may be alive at a time, so recasting replaces it instead of stacking another.

ParticleConfig.title: ParticleConfig
ParticleConfig.description: The particles the stage emits, when it is a particle stage rather than a wrapped effect.

ParticleId.title: ParticleId
ParticleId.description: The identifier the particle system is known by in the editor.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the particle system shows in the editor.

Amount.description: How many particles one emission produces.

LocalCoords.title: LocalCoords

EmitterShape.title: EmitterShape
EmitterShape.description: The shape the particles are emitted inside.

SphereRadius.title: SphereRadius
SphereRadius.description: How far from the emitter's centre particles may start when its shape is a sphere.

BoxExtents.title: BoxExtents
BoxExtents.description: How far from the emitter's centre particles may start on each axis when its shape is a box.

RingRadius.title: RingRadius
RingRadius.description: How far from the emitter's centre the ring the particles start on sits.

RingInnerRadius.title: RingInnerRadius
RingInnerRadius.description: The inner edge of the ring the particles start on, which makes it a band rather than a circle.

RingHeight.title: RingHeight
RingHeight.description: How tall the band the particles start in is.

Direction.title: Direction
Direction.description: The direction the particles are emitted in, before their spread is applied.

SpreadDegrees.title: SpreadDegrees
SpreadDegrees.description: How wide a cone the particles are emitted into around their direction.

InitialVelocityMin.title: InitialVelocityMin
InitialVelocityMin.description: The slowest speed a particle leaves the emitter with.

InitialVelocityMax.title: InitialVelocityMax
InitialVelocityMax.description: The fastest speed a particle leaves the emitter with.

LinearAccel.description: A constant acceleration added to every particle on each axis.

RadialAccel.title: RadialAccel
RadialAccel.description: How strongly particles are pushed away from the emitter's centre as they fly.

TangentialAccel.title: TangentialAccel
TangentialAccel.description: How strongly particles are pushed around the emitter's centre as they fly, which makes them swirl.

Damping.title: Damping
Damping.description: How quickly a particle's speed is bled away over its life, which slows a burst to a drift.

InitialScaleMin.title: InitialScaleMin
InitialScaleMin.description: The size a particle starts at when it is the smallest of the emission.

InitialScaleMax.title: InitialScaleMax
InitialScaleMax.description: The size a particle starts at when it is the largest of the emission.

EndScaleRatio.title: EndScaleRatio
EndScaleRatio.description: The size a particle ends at, as a fraction of the size it started at. Zero shrinks away, one never changes.

ColorStart.title: ColorStart
ColorStart.description: The colour a particle starts its life in.

ColorMid.title: ColorMid
ColorMid.description: The colour a particle passes through halfway through its life.

ColorEnd.title: ColorEnd
ColorEnd.description: The colour a particle ends its life in.

AlphaStart.title: AlphaStart
AlphaStart.description: How opaque a particle is when it starts its life.

AlphaMid.title: AlphaMid
AlphaMid.description: How opaque a particle is halfway through its life.

AlphaEnd.title: AlphaEnd
AlphaEnd.description: How opaque a particle is when its life ends.

BlendMode.title: BlendMode
BlendMode.description: How the particles are mixed with what is behind them.

ParticleTexture.title: ParticleTexture
ParticleTexture.description: The texture drawn on each particle when it is drawn as a camera-facing quad.

MeshAssetPath.title: MeshAssetPath
MeshAssetPath.description: The model drawn for each particle when it is drawn as a mesh, such as a chip of debris.

BlendMode.title: BlendMode
BlendMode.description: How the effect is mixed with what is behind it.

PlacementMode.title: PlacementMode
PlacementMode.description: How the effect is placed against the world when it is spawned.

TintWithPlayerColor.title: TintWithPlayerColor
TintWithPlayerColor.description: Whether the effect is tinted with the colour of the player it belongs to, so two armies' effects read apart.

TargetSocket.title: TargetSocket
TargetSocket.description: The socket of the model the effect is parented to, such as a hand, a weapon tip or the model's root.

BaseTexture.title: BaseTexture
BaseTexture.description: The texture wrapped over the effect's geometry, which gives it its streaks, rings or flames.

NoiseTexture.title: NoiseTexture
NoiseTexture.description: The noise texture the effect's distortion and erosion are read from.

ProceduralMotionId.title: ProceduralMotionId
ProceduralMotionId.description: The procedural motion profile the effect's geometry is animated with.

BaseUvScroll.title: BaseUvScroll
BaseUvScroll.description: How fast the base texture scrolls across the effect's geometry.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

BaseUvScale.title: BaseUvScale
BaseUvScale.description: How many times the base texture repeats over the effect's geometry.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

UseFlipbook.title: UseFlipbook
UseFlipbook.description: Whether the effect is animated from a sprite sheet rather than from a scrolling texture.

FlipbookColumns.title: FlipbookColumns
FlipbookColumns.description: How many frames the sprite sheet holds across.

FlipbookRows.title: FlipbookRows
FlipbookRows.description: How many frames the sprite sheet holds down.

FlipbookFps.title: FlipbookFps
FlipbookFps.description: How many sprite sheet frames the effect plays per second.

FlipbookSubframeBlend.title: FlipbookSubframeBlend
FlipbookSubframeBlend.description: Whether two neighbouring sprite sheet frames are blended while the effect plays.

NoiseUvScroll.title: NoiseUvScroll
NoiseUvScroll.description: How fast the noise texture scrolls across the effect's geometry.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

NoiseUvScale.title: NoiseUvScale
NoiseUvScale.description: How many times the noise texture repeats over the effect's geometry.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

DistortionStrength.title: DistortionStrength
DistortionStrength.description: How far the noise pushes the effect's texture around, which makes a flat shape read as turbulent.

BaseColor.title: BaseColor
BaseColor.description: The main colour the effect is drawn in.

SecondaryColor.title: SecondaryColor
SecondaryColor.description: The colour blended with the main colour away from the core, which gives the effect depth.

CoreColor.title: CoreColor
CoreColor.description: The colour of the brightest part of the effect, its core.

ColorMixRatio.title: ColorMixRatio
ColorMixRatio.description: How far the effect is mixed towards its secondary colour rather than its base colour.

EmissionBoost.title: EmissionBoost
EmissionBoost.description: How strongly the effect's colours glow, which additive blending turns into brightness.

CoreThreshold.title: CoreThreshold
CoreThreshold.description: The texture value above which the effect is drawn in its core colour.

LuminanceToAlpha.title: LuminanceToAlpha
LuminanceToAlpha.description: Whether the texture's brightness is turned into the effect's opacity, which is how a black-backed flame texture becomes a flame.

LuminanceThreshold.title: LuminanceThreshold
LuminanceThreshold.description: The brightness below which the texture is fully transparent when it is turned into opacity.

LuminanceSmoothness.title: LuminanceSmoothness
LuminanceSmoothness.description: How softly the brightness-to-opacity cutoff is applied.

UseGrayscale.title: UseGrayscale
UseGrayscale.description: Whether the effect works from the grayscale brightness of its texture rather than each colour channel.

InvertMask.title: InvertMask
InvertMask.description: Whether the effect's mask is inverted, so the parts that would be hidden are the parts that are drawn.

HighPassCutoff.title: HighPassCutoff
HighPassCutoff.description: The brightness the effect's mask is cut from, which removes its dim background entirely.

EnableRadialFalloff.title: EnableRadialFalloff
EnableRadialFalloff.description: Whether the effect fades out towards the edge of its shape instead of ending in a hard outline.

RadialFalloffStart.title: RadialFalloffStart
RadialFalloffStart.description: How far out the effect stays fully drawn before its radial fade begins.

RadialFalloffEnd.title: RadialFalloffEnd
RadialFalloffEnd.description: How far out the effect has faded away completely.

EnableLengthFade.title: EnableLengthFade
EnableLengthFade.description: Whether the effect fades along its length, which lets a beam or a trail end softly.

LengthFadeStart.title: LengthFadeStart
LengthFadeStart.description: How far along its length the effect stays fully drawn before its length fade begins.

LengthFadeEnd.title: LengthFadeEnd
LengthFadeEnd.description: How far along its length the effect has faded away completely.

ErosionProgress.title: ErosionProgress
ErosionProgress.description: How much the effect has eroded away, from whole to gone.

EnableFresnel.title: EnableFresnel
EnableFresnel.description: Whether the effect brightens where it turns away from the camera, which gives an aura a glowing rim.

FresnelPower.title: FresnelPower
FresnelPower.description: How tightly the effect's rim glow hugs its silhouette.

FresnelIntensity.title: FresnelIntensity
FresnelIntensity.description: How strong the effect's rim glow is.

EnableDepthFade.title: EnableDepthFade
EnableDepthFade.description: Whether the effect fades where it cuts into the ground or another solid surface.

DepthFadeDistance.title: DepthFadeDistance
DepthFadeDistance.description: How far the effect has to be inside another surface before it has faded away.

SurfaceNormalOffset.title: SurfaceNormalOffset
SurfaceNormalOffset.description: How far the effect is lifted along the surface normal, so it does not fight the surface for the same depth.

PositionOffset.title: PositionOffset
PositionOffset.description: Where the effect sits relative to what it is attached to.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

RotationOffset.title: RotationOffset
RotationOffset.description: How the effect is turned relative to what it is attached to, in degrees around each axis.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

ScaleOffset.title: ScaleOffset
ScaleOffset.description: The multiplier applied to the effect's size on each axis.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the effect was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

CameraBoundsLeft.title: CameraBoundsLeft
CameraBoundsLeft.description: The west edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsRight.title: CameraBoundsRight
CameraBoundsRight.description: The east edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsTop.title: CameraBoundsTop
CameraBoundsTop.description: The north edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsBottom.title: CameraBoundsBottom
CameraBoundsBottom.description: The south edge of the area the camera may pan to.

SkyboxPath.title: SkyboxPath
SkyboxPath.description: Path to the skybox drawn behind this map's battlefield.

Coordinates.title: Coordinates
Coordinates.description: The named rectangles of the battlefield a map's slots and script refer to.

items.description: One named rectangle of the battlefield, such as a start location or a capture zone, that a map's script and slots refer to by name.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the map's slots and script refer to this coordinate by.

MinX.title: MinX
MinX.description: The west edge of the coordinate's rectangle.

MinZ.title: MinZ
MinZ.description: The north edge of the coordinate's rectangle.

MaxX.title: MaxX
MaxX.description: The east edge of the coordinate's rectangle.

MaxZ.title: MaxZ
MaxZ.description: The south edge of the coordinate's rectangle.

SpawnAnchors.title: SpawnAnchors
SpawnAnchors.description: Where each player's units start a match on this map.

items.description: Where one player's units start a match on this map, named after the coordinate that holds the starting area.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: The slot whose starting area this anchor is.

CoordinateName.title: CoordinateName
CoordinateName.description: The coordinate that holds the slot's starting area.
